title: NFTMigrator lacks reentrancy guard on migrate()
description: migrate() makes multiple cross-contract calls in nested loops (v1.burn and v2.mintFor per V1 index). Each v2.mintFor triggers ERC1155._mint which invokes onERC1155Received on the caller. A contract-based caller can re-enter migrate() from the callback. While analysis shows this is not currently exploitable (V1 tokens are burned before V2 minting per-index, and re-entering would find zero balances for processed indexes), no ReentrancyGuard is applied.
impact: Defense-in-depth concern. Not currently exploitable but relies on fragile code ordering.
recommendation: Apply nonReentrant from OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard to migrate().
